workflow_baseline.line_strategy: cleaner controlled linework may be prominent when supported by current artwork
workflow_baseline.color_strategy: shape readability and controlled base-color separation before refinement
workflow_baseline.texture_strategy: texture is conditional and should not be forced when the artwork is clean/flat
workflow_baseline.detail_strategy: specialized decorative/detail roles are retained when they materially improve repeatability or speed
